title: The Historical Regions of Europe
goal: I can describe a legal order with a participle before the noun, as in *a hatalmat korlátozó jogrend*.
I can say what was given with a past participle, as in *a királytól kapott szabadságok*.
I can use the main words of regional history: *joguralom*, *második jobbágyság*, *társadalmi autonómia*.
